cards.card_text: he falls APART, with his head and hands lying on the threshold and only the torso left.
cards.verse_text: But when they got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD, with his head and his hands broken off and lying on the threshold.
cards.snippet: …with his head and his hands broken off and lying on the threshold.

cards.card_text: When this was written, Dagon's priests and everyone entering his temple in Ashdod still did not step on the threshold.
cards.verse_text: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.
cards.snippet: …enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.

cards.card_text: Jeroboam's son dies as soon as she steps over the threshold of the house.
cards.verse_text: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and departed for Tirzah, and as soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
cards.snippet: …and departed for Tirzah, and as soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.

cards.card_text: The priests who guard the threshold drop in all the money brought to the house of the LORD.
cards.verse_text: There the priests who guarded the threshold put all the money brought into the house of the LORD.
cards.snippet: There the priests who guarded the threshold put all the money brought into the house of the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then the glory of the God of Israel rises from above the cherubim and moves to the threshold of the temple, and friend, when the glory of God moves, EVERYBODY should be paying attention.
cards.verse_text: Then the glory of the God of Israel rose from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple.
cards.snippet: …from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple.

cards.card_text: He measures that gate piece by piece: its threshold, its gate chambers, three on each side, its portico and its gateposts.
cards.verse_text: He measured the threshold of the gate to be one rod deep.
cards.snippet: He measured the threshold of the gate to be one rod deep.

cards.card_text: Before, they put their threshold right next to His, with only a wall between Him and them.
cards.verse_text: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts, with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed.

cards.card_text: Before the prince departs, what does he do at the threshold of the gate?
cards.verse_text: He is to bow in worship at the threshold of the gate and then depart, but the gate must not be shut until evening.

cards.card_text: Ezekiel looks down at the threshold and sees something coming out from under it, heading east.
cards.verse_text: Then the man brought me back to the entrance of the temple, and I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east).
cards.snippet: …entrance of the temple, and I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east).

cards.card_text: On that day, He says, He will punish all who leap over the threshold.
cards.verse_text: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
cards.snippet: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.

cards.card_text: Desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.
cards.verse_text: Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.
